title.narrative: Future Proofing the Grain Value Chain in Northern Ghana

description.narrative: Impact: The expected effect on society is strengthened food security in rural Northern Ghana. Outcomes: Expected effects for the direct target group (see bottom of section) are 1. Agricultural sector is strengthened through market linkages, 2. Farmers access high-quality inputs and services through hubs, and 3. Farmers use regenerative agricultural practices. Outputs: Warc will open 25 trading hubs in rural Northern Ghana (half with 2x50MT silos), creating 185 direct jobs (40% women), serving 15,000 farmers with improved inputs, technical training, and providing fair markets. Warc will purchase 15,000MT maize from farmers, adding EUR 5.3 million to their incomes and sell to downstream buyers, including Koudijs Ghana, one of Ghana’s largest poultry feed processors, and Nestle. Intended target groups are farmers in Northern Ghana (direct target group) and the population of Northern Ghana at large (end target group).
